(a public company incorporated with limited liability in Ireland)
RESULTS OF MEETING OF THE ETP SECURITYHOLDERS
WisdomTree Multi Asset Issuer Public Limited Company (the “
”) wishes to announce that the Extraordinary Resolution regarding the reduction in the principal amount of the WisdomTree FTSE 100 3x Daily Short Securities (the “

”) from GBx 20 to GBx 2, as set out in a notice to holders of the Affected Securities dated 27 August 2026, was passed at an adjourned meeting of the holders of the Affected Securities held at 11am on 21 September 2026.
As a result, the Deed of Amendment has been duly executed by the Issuer, the Manager and the Trustee to put the proposed amendments to the Trust Deed into effect from 21 September 2026.
